items.quote: - [x] **HIPP-01**: After a real HippoRAG ingest (chunk-embed writes), a query on the normal PPR path
- [x] **HIPP-02**: reset-vector-join's passage weights are keyed by the same strings as the graph's chunk vertex names
- [x] **HIPP-03**: When any node of an ingest wiring fails, Engine.ingest commits none of the staged writes
- [x] **HIPP-04**: A HippoRAG ingest refusal carries the real exception of the node that failed
- [x] **HIPP-05**: The fact-filter node receives the query text: fact-filter is listed in consumes_query of wirings/hipporag/base.json
- [x] **HIPP-06**: Every chunk produced by chunk-embed gets a passage vertex in the HippoRAG graph after ingest
- [x] **HIPP-07**: synonymy-edges matches the entities new in the current ingest against all entities
- [x] **HIPP-08**: HippoRAG edge weights and edge_types accumulate across ingests
- [x] **HIPP-09**: A fact extracted from different documents in separate ingests keeps the union of chunk_ids
- [x] **HIPP-10**: OpenIE extraction failures are reported: malformed NER or triple JSON responses and per-chunk chat() exceptions are counted per chunk
